semantic_atoms.claim: Visual Cortex is a coupled pipeline: shared CaptureWorker -> UnifiedDB memory context -> perception-gated visual candidates -> the same voice_loop_core score/arbitration machinery -> structured visual_event/presence_episode persistence. It explicitly reuses policy, GWT scoring and shared capture instead of inventing parallel mechanisms.

semantic_atoms.claim: Voice uses explicit candidate scoring with hard user-present/self-resolvable gates, weighted benefit-cost terms, chatter debt for initiative acts, and WAIT as a first-class default winner unless a real candidate reaches threshold.

semantic_atoms.claim: When PresenceBridge cannot import, start, or access the camera, the live Realtime path explicitly falls back to the old user_present=True default while the VoiceSessionCapsule can separately represent no presence signal.
semantic_atoms.contradiction: This conflicts with the desired FACT_UNKNOWN + METHOD_PRESENT != FACT_PRESENT discipline: missing sensor evidence is not evidence that the user is present.
semantic_atoms.grid10_adaptation: Replace True fallback with UNKNOWN/None and make candidate hard gates define explicit behavior for UNKNOWN (normally WAIT/ASK/re-observe depending on act), preserving a provenance reason for degradation.
open_questions: Audit all vlc.kandidaten_bauen call sites for implicit True defaults and add an unknown-presence regression test.

semantic_atoms.claim: Action-grounded memory implements a pre-evidence -> action -> post-evidence -> outcome loop, reuses perception policy and typed evidence, records provenance, and structurally prevents memory priors from overwriting fresh post-action evidence.

semantic_atoms.grid10_adaptation: Retain post-effect re-observation/outcome binding but route any real effect request through canonical deterministic EffectGate/EffectJournal authority; this module must not become an alternate effect authority.
open_questions: Map action IDs to EffectJournal request/result identities and test unknown external-effect outcomes without blind replay.

semantic_atoms.grid10_adaptation: Preserve outcome re-entry as a causal feedback edge into GRID/GWT. Keep re-look bounded, typed and provenance-bearing.
open_questions: Inspect P3V execution receipts and exact initiative_episode schema migration before claiming runtime coverage for all five voice outcome kinds.
